metadata.text:
As this enters play, it becomes
an item. The active player gains it.
------------------------------
When this item enters your
control, gain 2¢, then roll-

1-4: Give this to the player
to your left.
------------------------------
5: Destroy this, then take 3 damage.
------------------------------
6: This becomes a soul.
(+1 soul)

metadata.text:
All non-active players
secretly decide together on
which non-active player is guilty
till end of turn. Then, the active
player chooses a non-active player.
If the chosen player is guilty,
they die and the active player
gains +1 treasure. Otherwise, the
guilty player gains +1 treasure
and the active player skips
their next turn.
metadata.notes:
